card.name: Single digits inside names and codes
card.fires_on: A single digit that completes a name or code, such as the 3 in 5-HT3, the 1 in H1N1 or the 5 in HTML5. It sits right after a letter or a hyphenated label.

modes.label: Serotonin receptor subtype
modes.description: The digit after 5-HT in antiemetic or migraine drug text.

modes.label: Virus and technology names
modes.description: A digit ending a strain or language name, or a digit inside a reference code.

card.writes: It promotes spelled-out number words such as fifteen and seventy and suppresses plain digit tokens, so it shifts the model away from another digit.
card.plain: It fires on the final digit in labels like 5-HT3 or H1N1, where the number is part of a name.
